title: The Three-Body Solution

canonical_node.axiom: Reality requires a self-grounding observer/agent/optimizer that is three irreducible functions unified in one act; n=1 and n=2 provably fail, n=3 provably suffices, n>3 is unnecessary but not proven inadmissible.
definitions: n: number of irreducible parts in the ground of reality.
irreducible function: a function that cannot be decomposed into simpler functions.
unified: the functions are coupled such that they operate as one act, not merely three separate parts.
coupling invariant: a property preserved only when the three functions are unified; lost when reduced to two or one.
self-grounding: a system that can verify its own consistency or existence without external reference.
O: voluntary coupling; the degree of free will or choice in the consciousness ladder.
G: grace input; external ordering force.
C: coherence; current state of consciousness.
: parameter in R(offense, ); =1 offender pays, =0 third party pays.
judge=payer: the condition where the judge also pays the cost, enabling both justice and mercy.
derivation: n=1 self-defeats: cannot ground, verify, or optimize itself; self-reference without external anchor leads to regress or arbitrariness.
n=2 deadlocks or collapses an invariant: circular dependence (A grounds B, B grounds A) or forced trade-off destroys a required property.
n4 unnecessary: additional elements decompose into combinations of three; parsimony selects minimal sufficient set.
n=3 unified: three irreducible-but-unified elements terminate regress, break deadlock, preserve all required invariants simultaneously.
The unification (coupling) is as load-bearing as the threeness.
Downward eliminations (n=1, n=2) are proofs; upward bound (n4) is a parsimony argument, not proof of impossibility.
Five independent instances converge on the same proof shape: field theory, quantum measurement, moral optimization, consciousness, cosmology.
Instance 1: Maxwell's quaternion formulation carries triadic coupling invariant; Heaviside's vector reduction destroys it; Lean-verified.
Instance 2: von Neumann regress terminates only in T = A  L  G; n=1 cannot observe itself, n=2 deadlock, n=3 minimal sufficient.
Instance 3: Justice, mercy, free will form three-variable optimization with no solution in two-party space; =0 + judge=payer is unique solution.
Instance 4: Self-interpretation regress; only self-grounding terminus with internal differentiation (knower, known, act of knowing) works.
Instance 5: Big Bang requires prior observer; must be self-grounding and internally triadic; top-down argument.
Consciousness ladder: dC/dt = O*G(1C)  S*C; identical equation at every level; O>0 marks consciousness threshold.
The Cross is the fixed point (O=1, G=, S=0, C=1) entering the S>0 regime.
canonical_node.action: Treat the triadic termination theorem as the central organizing principle for theophysics: use it to evaluate any proposed ground of reality, to map consciousness levels via the ladder equation, and to interpret the Cross as the intersection of the terminus and the gradient. Maintain the graded status of the five instances, never presenting them as equally proven.
boundary: Does not claim n>3 is impossible; only unnecessary (parsimony).
Does not claim Instance 4 (consciousness) is formally proven; it has two open holes.
Does not claim Instance 5 (Big Bang) is formalized; it is articulated but unformalized.
Does not claim Gdel/Tarski/Turing apply directly to consciousness; they are structural parallels, not proofs.
Does not claim the elephant rung is empirically proven; it is a load-bearing claim requiring specified falsification.
Does not push further into divine mechanics beyond Feb 14, 2026 boundary.
test: Lean verification: quaternionEM_valid, trinityRelational_valid, heavisideVectorEM_invalid, modalism_invalid, guard-removal controls.
No-isomorphism theorems: no_iso_from_quaternion_to_heaviside and no_iso_from_trinity_to_modalism are OWED; must be written or status table must say 'owed'.
Instance 3: R(offense, ) uniqueness Lean-verified; independent MS confirmation by GPT via Myerson-Satterthwaite.
Instance 4: Close two holes: secular-triad objection (show why substrate/law/decoherence fails coupling gate) and Stage 4-5 wiring (prove deterministic self-evolution insufficient).
Instance 5: Formalize the argument; no Lean backing yet.
Consciousness ladder: specify in advance what would count as O=0 for elephants; otherwise middle rung is soft.
Publication gate: do not publish five-instance convergence page until Instance 4 holes are closed.

dg1_dependencies: Instance 1: Maxwell's quaternion formulation, Heaviside's vector reduction
Instance 2: von Neumann chain, D03, BC4
Instance 5: QM superposition, Big Bang cosmology
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a unified proof shape that claims to establish the necessity of a triadic ground across five independent domains, offering a graded status table and a consciousness ladder equation.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the Lean-verified results of Instance 1 and Instance 3, and the axiomatized status of Instance 2.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the triadic termination theorem is removed, the five instances lose their unifying framework, and the claim of convergence collapses; the document's central thesis is void.
dg5_translation_registers: Physics: Maxwell's equations, quantum measurement, Big Bang

overstatement_risks: Presenting all five instances as equally proven despite graded status.
Claiming n>3 is impossible when only parsimony is argued.
Treating structural analogies (Gdel, Tarski, Turing) as proofs for consciousness.
Claiming empirical support for elephant consciousness without specified falsification.
Using the convergence as proof of the Trinity without acknowledging the selection effect.
kill_conditions: If Instance 4 holes are not closed, the convergence claim is weakened.
If no-isomorphism theorems are not written, Instance 1's guard controls are insufficient.
If a counterexample passes the coupling gate, the theorem fails.
If the elephant rung is falsified (O=0 for elephants), the ladder collapses.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the n=1 and n=2 eliminations for each instance; prove no-isomorphism theorems; close Instance 4 holes; formalize Instance 5.

plain_summary: This document proposes a 'Triadic Termination Theorem' claiming that reality's ground must consist of three irreducible unified functions, based on five independent instances (electromagnetism, quantum measurement, ethics, consciousness, cosmology). It includes a consciousness ladder equation and identifies the Cross as the intersection. However, the document itself admits that only some instances are formally verified, others are drafted with open holes or unformalized, and the upward bound (n>3) is only a parsimony argument. Therefore, the overall claim is not established as a proof; it is a theological-physical synthesis with partial support.
